stem:
Students study barracudas. They gather some observations of barracudas. A barracuda is shown.

Which observation describes barracudas interacting with the living elements of their ecosystem?

options.label: F
options.text: Barracudas can travel quickly using surface ocean currents.

options.label: G
options.text: Barracudas live around hard structures such as oil rigs and jetties.

options.label: H
options.text: Barracudas are predators of other fish.

options.label: J
options.text: Barracudas tend to live in warm waters.

visual_elements: Photo of a barracuda fish underwater
